clinicalWorkspace.preliminaryAiDisclaimerBody: Artificial Intelligence screening is strictly a preliminary diagnostic aid. AI results must never be presented as the final diagnosis. As the licensed veterinarian, you are required to conduct clinical evaluation and enter your explicit diagnosis and treatment protocol.
clinicalWorkspace.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Give orally after feeding / Intramuscular
clinicalWorkspace.declineModalSubtitle: Declining will automatically reassign this request to the next available veterinarian.
clinicalWorkspace.declineReasonPlaceholder: Provide clinical rationale (e.g. out of service area, specialist referral required)...
clinicalWorkspace.step2Subtitle: Document your physical observations, vital signs, temperature, and visible cattle symptoms.
clinicalWorkspace.step3Subtitle: As the attending doctor, confirm and record your authoritative clinical diagnosis. This will overwrite preliminary AI estimates.
clinicalWorkspace.step4Subtitle: Add prescribed medicines, dosages, frequencies, and administration instructions for the farmer.
clinicalWorkspace.step5Subtitle: Schedule an optional follow-up date and mark the clinical consultation as complete.
clinicalWorkspace.timelineSubtitle: Audit log of case creation, doctor assignment, referral history, examination, diagnosis, and prescription.
clinicalWorkspace.physicalSymptomsPlaceholder: Record visible physical signs e.g., skin lesions, udder swelling, nasal discharge, fever, lameness...
clinicalWorkspace.observationsPlaceholder: Detail overall health condition, hydration status, rumination activity, behavior...
clinicalWorkspace.additionalNotesPlaceholder: Any other relevant details or history provided by the farmer...
clinicalWorkspace.diagnosisPlaceholder: e.g. Acute Mastitis (Left Hind Quarter), Lumpy Skin Disease, Foot & Mouth Disease...
clinicalWorkspace.diagnosisNotesPlaceholder: Explain why this diagnosis was reached, pathological observations, laboratory findings...
clinicalWorkspace.treatmentAdvicePlaceholder: Outline clinical treatment protocol, injection procedures, isolation requirements...
clinicalWorkspace.careAdvicePlaceholder: Sanitation advice, milking hygiene, calf segregation, diet adjustments...
clinicalWorkspace.generalInstructionsPlaceholder: Detail instructions e.g. apply teat dip after milking, keep animal clean, complete full antibiotic course...
clinicalWorkspace.dietaryAdvicePlaceholder: Feed modifications, fresh water intake, mineral mixture supplements...
clinicalWorkspace.followUpPlaceholder: e.g. Schedule check-up if fever persists after 3 days, monitor milk yield recovery...
